title: Aureline M5 owner conflict reconciliation
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for an owner-conflict reconciliation — the typed explanation Aureline surfaces when a CODEOWNERS repo rule, a graph-derived maintainer overlay, and a provider-suggested reviewer disagree about who owns a slice. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the reconciliation binding (owner authority — advisory versus enforced, owner source provenance — repo rule versus graph overlay versus provider metadata, or owner conflict rationale — the winning versus advisory relationship), and the reviewer rationale so an advisory owner is never silently promoted into an enforced merge gate and a conflicting owner set never collapses into one ambiguous owner pill. Downstream review lists, review detail, the ownership overlay, merge-readiness, AI review, browser handoff, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating the reconciliation by hand. Raw paths, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
